speaker: author (devotional voice)
question: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light — yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power.
premises: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light.
Yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power.
Division shines without dividing the light.
inference: Positive declaration after denial; division within the undivided.
uncertainties: Whether 'ittham' (thus) refers back to p01-p02 or opens a new movement is unresolved.
